تزدرعي (form VIII)
# تَزْدَرِعِي (tazdariʕī) /taz.da.ri.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# تُزْدَرَعِي (tuzdaraʕī) /tuz.da.ra.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
